M-401 (VAV AIR HANDLING UNIT WITH MINIMUM OUTSIDE AIR): supply fan VSMC on duct static pressure reset by polling the terminal units; return fan VSMC holding supply minus return airflow at the minimum outside air (no separate minimum OA damper); dry-bulb economizer against a fixed 75 F limit and the supply temperature; freezestat hardwired to the supply fan drive and monitored (mixed air low limit BI); the duct smoke detectors report to the fire alarm system and have no BAS point. VA project (not DoD).
Supply fan array of WHSE-AHU-1 (schedule service 'WHSE-AHU-1'); its points are the air handler's (M-401), so no separate fan typical.
Return fan of WHSE-AHU-1 (schedule service 'WHSE-AHU-1'); its points are the air handler's (M-401), so no separate fan typical.

Toilet/breakroom exhaust fan, schedule SPEED CONTROL 'CONSTANT'. No control diagram or sequence covers it: typical from the schedule on a BACnet BAS project (M-400 control system configuration), its damper option not shown. VA project (not DoD).

Forklift-area exhaust fan, schedule SPEED CONTROL 'VARIABLE'. No control diagram or sequence covers it: typical from the schedule on a BACnet BAS project (M-400 control system configuration), its options not shown. VA project (not DoD).
Clean-steam dispersion humidifier in WHSE-AHU-1. M-400 detail 5 and M-401 section 4: return air humidity (MT-2) modulates the valve, supply air high limit, airflow switch. VA project (not DoD).

M-400 detail 1 (DUAL HEAT EXCHANGER CONTROLS): 1/3-2/3 steam control valves hold the leaving hot water temperature on an outdoor reset; duty/standby with HX2. No isolation valve and no condensate pump point (condensate to the existing return station). VA project (not DoD).
